questions.stem: A 58 year old woman has an anterior nasal pack inserted for a nosebleed from Little's area that did not respond to cautery. The pack is soaked in water and inflated with air once in place. Her bleeding stops within minutes. A student asks how the pack works.
questions.q: Which is the main mechanism by which the pack stops the bleeding?
o: Activation of platelets by the pack material
Direct tamponade of the bleeding vessel
questions.e: Nasal packs work by direct tamponade of the bleeding vessel; failure suggests a more proximal or larger-vessel source needing ligation.
